current.name: ASML (ADR)
current.utility: ASML designs and manufactures extreme‑ultraviolet (EUV) and High‑NA lithography systems that print the microscopic circuit patterns on silicon wafers; its customers are the world’s leading semiconductor makers such as Intel, TSMC and Samsung.
evidence: €27.6 billion net sales in 2023, including €5.6 billion of EUV bookings in Q4 — ASML press release, 24 Jan 2024
Shipped 421 new lithography systems in 2023 (including the first High‑NA EUV tool) — ASML press release, 24 Jan 2024
Second High‑NA EUV machine delivered to an unnamed customer, with potential buyers TSMC and Samsung, each machine priced around €350 million — Reuters, 17 Apr 2024
current.whyNow: The recent $40 billion AI‑chip financing deal announced by SpaceX underscores accelerating demand for advanced chips, which in turn drives immediate need for ASML’s next‑generation lithography tools.
risks: Tight export‑control regimes that could restrict sales to key customers.
The extremely high cost of High‑NA systems may delay orders if semiconductor manufacturers curb capex amid macro‑economic uncertainty.

sources.title: ASML reports €27.6 billion net sales and €7.8 billion net income in 2023 | Wed, 01/24/2024 - 07:00
